title: Personal Narrative
summary: إزاي تحكي قصة حقيقية عن شخص ساعدك تبقى أثقف في نفسك: البداية والنص والنهاية، والأزمنة الصح، والدرس اللي اتعلمته (150-180 كلمة).

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: A **personal narrative** is a true story about an experience from your life. It explains what happened, who was involved, how you felt and what you learned or how you changed.

blocks.text: الـ **personal narrative** يعني «قصة شخصية حقيقية». إنت بتحكي **موقف حصل لك فعلًا**: إيه اللي حصل، مين كان معاك، كنت حاسس بإيه، و**اتعلمت إيه** أو **اتغيرت إزاي** بعدها.

في الكتاب الدرس ده في **Unit 9: Circles of Belonging**، جزء **9.2 Relationships That Help Us Grow** (صفحة 113). الجزء ده بيتكلم عن الـ **growth relationship**: علاقة مع حد (mentor، مدرس، حد من العيلة، أو صاحب) **بتساعدك تكبر** وتبقى أشطر وأثقف في نفسك وأقوى. والمطلوب قصة من **150-180 كلمة** عن **شخص ساعدك تبقى أثقف في نفسك أو أشطر (more confident or capable)**.
وفي **Consolidation Review E** فيه سؤال MCQ: الـ personal narrative لازم يكون فيه **تجربة حقيقية، والناس اللي كانوا فيها، وإزاي غيّرت الكاتب**.
الفكرة ببساطة: «حكاية + درس»

text: A good personal narrative has a clear **beginning**, **middle** and **ending**. It tells a story, but it also shows how the writer changed.

blocks.text: تخيل إنك بتحكي لصاحبك موقف: «فاكر لما كنت خايف من الامتحان الشفوي؟ ابن عمي فضل يذاكر معايا، وفي الآخر عديت، ومن ساعتها بقيت مش بخاف أتكلم». دي بالظبط الـ personal narrative: **موقف ← مساعدة ← نتيجة ← تغيير**.
الفرق بينها وبين القصة الخيالية: هنا القصة **عنك إنت** ومكتوبة بضمير **I** (أنا)، ولازم تختم **بدرس أو تغيير** حصلك، مش بس «وعاشوا في تبات ونبات».

مثال من الكتاب نفسه: قراءة **Finding My Place: A New Student's Story** (Unit 9.1) هي personal narrative: الكاتب نقل من إسكندرية لمدينة جديدة (**البداية**)، زميلة في الفصل ساعدت الكاتب في جنينة المدرسة (**النص**)، اشترك في نادي البيئة وبقى له مكان (**النهاية**)، واتعلم إن الانتماء بيتبني بالراحة (**الدرس**).
الهيكل: البداية والنص والنهاية

text: The writing task in the book gives five points. They fit into three parts: beginning, middle and ending.

rows: **Beginning** (البداية)
1. introduce the person and your relationship with them
قدّم الشخص: هو مين؟ قريبك إيه؟ وكان ده إمتى وفين؟
When I was in…, / My older cousin, …, was… / We had always been close, but…
**Middle** (النص)

2. describe a problem or difficult situation you faced
3. explain how this person supported or encouraged you
المشكلة اللي قابلتك وكنت حاسس بإيه، وبعدين الشخص ده **عمل إيه بالظبط** علشان يساعدك.
At first, … / I was so nervous that… / One evening, while I was…, … / Instead of…, he…
**Ending** (النهاية)

4. describe what happened as a result
5. explain how the experience changed you
النتيجة (إيه اللي حصل في الآخر) + إزاي اتغيرت + الدرس.
In the end, … / As a result, … / That experience taught me that… / Now I…

blocks.text: الأزمنة: Past Simple و Past Continuous

text: Use the **past simple** for the main events of the story. Use the **past continuous** for actions in progress or for the background.

blocks.text: الكتاب بيقول بوضوح: الـ personal narrative **غالبًا** بيستخدم:

rows: **Past simple**
V2 (went, helped, felt, decided)
**الأحداث الأساسية** اللي حصلت ورا بعض
He **listened** carefully and **gave** me advice.
**Past continuous**
was / were + V-ing
حدث **كان مستمر** في وقت معين، أو **الخلفية** (الجو / المكان)
I **was rehearsing** in my room when he knocked.
**Past perfect** (زيادة)
had + V3
حاجة حصلت **قبل** حدث تاني في الماضي
We **had** always **been** close before that year.

blocks.text: الحيلة: **الـ past continuous = الخلفية** (الحدث الطويل)، و**الـ past simple = الحدث اللي قطعه** (الحدث القصير). وبيربطهم **while** أو **when**:

items.en: **While** I **was practising** my speech, my cousin **knocked** on the door.
items.ar: كنت بتمرن (حدث مستمر) ← ابن عمي خبط (حدث قصير قطعه).

items.en: It **was raining** heavily, and everyone **was waiting** quietly in the hall.
items.ar: past continuous لوصف **الخلفية** والجو قبل الحدث.

items.en: My voice **was shaking** and my hands **were sweating**.
items.ar: past continuous لوصف **إحساس مستمر** في اللحظة دي.

items.en: I **walked** onto the stage, **took** a deep breath and **started** to speak.

blocks.text: خلي القصة عايشة: المشاعر و so…that / such…that

text: A personal narrative must show **how you felt**. The grammar of Unit 9, **so…that** and **such…that**, is perfect for showing strong feelings and their results.

rows: **so** + adjective / adverb + **that**
صفة أو ظرف
I was **so nervous that** I could not sleep.
**such** (a / an) + adjective + noun + **that**
اسم (معاه صفة)
It was **such a kind gesture that** I almost cried.

blocks.title: Show, don't just tell
items: بدل **I was scared.** بس ← اكتب كمان اللي بيبيّن الخوف: **My voice was shaking and my hands were sweating.**
بدل **He helped me.** ← قول **عمل إيه بالظبط**: **He listened to my speech every evening and gave me honest feedback.**

blocks.text: عبارات مفيدة (Useful Phrases)

groups.title: Beginning: introducing the person
items: My older cousin, …, was studying… at the time.
We had always been close, but I never imagined that…

groups.title: Time connectors (ترتيب الأحداث)
items: At first / Then / After that / Later / Finally

blocks.text: إزاي تكتب القصة خطوة بخطوة

items: **اختار شخص حقيقي** ساعدك: مدرس، مدرب، أخ/أخت أكبر، ابن عم، جار، أو صاحب.
**اختار موقف واحد بس** (مش كل حياتك): امتحان، مسابقة، ماتش، أول يوم في مدرسة جديدة، عرض قدام الفصل.
**اكتب الخطة في 5 سطور** (واحد لكل نقطة من نقاط الكتاب الخمسة).
**البداية**: عرّف الشخص وعلاقتك بيه، وإمتى ده كان.
**المشكلة**: اوصف الموقف وإحساسك (so…that / past continuous للخلفية).
**النتيجة**: إيه اللي حصل في الآخر (past simple).
**التغيير**: اختم بجملة فيها الدرس **That experience taught me that…** وإنت بقيت إزاي دلوقتي.
**راجع**: الأزمنة صح؟ كل الجمل بضمير I؟ العدد 150-180 كلمة؟

blocks.text: نموذج كامل (Model Answer)

blocks.title: Personal Narrative: The Cousin Who Believed in Me
blocks.task: Write a personal narrative of (150-180) words about a person who helped you become more confident or capable.
text: The Cousin Who Believed in Me

When I was in my first year of secondary school, my older cousin Youssef was studying engineering at university. We had always been close, but I never imagined that he would change the way I saw myself.

That year, my teacher chose me to present our class project at the school science fair. I was so nervous that I could not sleep for three nights. Whenever I practised, my voice was shaking and my hands were sweating.

One evening, while I was rehearsing in my room, Youssef knocked on the door. Instead of giving me empty praise, he listened carefully and gave me honest feedback. He came back every evening that week, and he let me make mistakes in front of him so that I could learn from them.
On the day of the fair, I spoke clearly and answered the judges' questions calmly.
That experience taught me that confidence is built step by step. Now I volunteer to speak in class, and I try to support younger students in the same way.
blocks.marks: يغطي نقاط الـ Writing Task الخمسة في الكتاب
notes: **نقطة 1 (introduce the person)**: الفقرة الأولى بتعرّفنا مين يوسف (older cousin، بيدرس هندسة) والعلاقة (We had always been close). والـ **past continuous** (was studying) للخلفية والـ **past perfect** (had always been) لحاجة قبل القصة.
**نقطة 2 (problem)**: الـ science fair والتوتر: **I was so nervous that I could not sleep** (تركيب الوحدة so…that) + **Show, don't tell**: my voice was shaking and my hands were sweating.

**نقطة 3 (support)**: **while I was rehearsing… Youssef knocked** (حدث مستمر اتقطع بحدث قصير). ودعم **محدد**: honest feedback بدل empty praise، و**consistency** (every evening that week)، وإنه **سابه يغلط** علشان يتعلم. دي نفس صفات الـ growth relationship اللي في درس الاستماع في الوحدة.
**نقطة 4 (result)**: جملة واحدة واضحة بالـ past simple: spoke clearly and answered… calmly.
**نقطة 5 (change)**: **That experience taught me that…** + **Now I…** = الكاتب اتغير وبقى بيساعد غيره.
**ضمير I** في القصة كلها، والأحداث بالترتيب بـ time expressions (When / That year / One evening / On the day of…).

blocks.text: أشهر الأخطاء

blocks.title: غلط ← صح
items: ✗ القصة كلها بالمضارع: I go to the fair and I am nervous. ← ✓ I **went** to the fair and I **was** nervous.
✗ While I rehearsed, he was knocking on the door. ← ✓ While I **was rehearsing**, he **knocked** on the door.
✗ I was so nervous so I could not sleep. ← ✓ I was so nervous **that** I could not sleep.
✗ It was so a kind gesture that… ← ✓ It was **such** a kind gesture that…
✗ He helped me a lot. (وخلاص) ← ✓ قول **عمل إيه بالظبط**: He listened to my speech every evening.
✗ تنهي القصة بالنتيجة بس ← ✓ لازم تضيف **إزاي اتغيرت / اتعلمت إيه**.
✗ قصة خيالية عن تنين أو بطل خارق ← ✓ تجربة **حقيقية** من حياتك.
✗ تكتب القصة كلها فقرة واحدة ← ✓ **beginning / middle / ending** في فقرات واضحة.

blocks.text: إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟
الأسئلة في الكتاب والمراجعات بتيجي بالشكل ده:
**1) MCQ عن الـ genre (زي Consolidation Review E):**

text: Which of these is the best topic for a personal narrative? a) The history of the pyramids b) The day my grandfather taught me to swim and how it made me braver c) How to bake a chocolate cake d) Why cars pollute the air

blocks.text: **الإجابة: b** — فيها **تجربة حقيقية + شخص (الجد) + تغيير (بقيت أشجع)**، وده بالظبط الـ personal narrative. الباقي معلومات أو تعليمات مش قصة من حياتك.
**2) اختار الزمن الصح:**

text: I (walk) home when I (see) my old teacher.

blocks.text: **الإجابة:** I **was walking** home when I **saw** my old teacher. — المشي كان مستمر (past continuous)، والشوفة حدث قصير قطعه (past simple).
**3) سؤال عن قراءة personal narrative (زي Finding My Place):**

text: By the end of the first term, the writer says they were no longer 'the new student who ate alone'. What does this show about how the writer changed?

blocks.text: **إجابة نموذجية:** It shows that the writer had started to belong. They had joined the environmental club, had a role and had people who would notice if they were absent. — يعني الكاتب اتحول من طالب وحيد لحد ليه مكان ودور في المدرسة. (لاحظ إن الإجابة بكلامك وبالدليل من النص.)
قائمة المراجعة (Checklist)

items: استخدمت **past simple** للأحداث و**past continuous** للخلفية؟
فيه **beginning / middle / ending** واضحين؟ والعدد **150-180** كلمة؟

blocks.text: تدريب
**أولًا: اختار الإجابة الصحيحة (a / b / c / d)**

items.q:
1. A personal narrative is …
a) an imaginary story  b) a true story about an experience from your life  c) a news report  d) a formal letter
items.a: **b** — تعريف الكتاب: a true story about an experience from your life.

items.q:
2. While I … for the bus, I met my old coach.
a) waited  b) was waiting  c) wait  d) am waiting
items.a: **b** — حدث مستمر (past continuous) اتقطع بحدث قصير (met).

items.q:
3. My sister … me with my maths every evening last term.
a) helps  b) was help  c) helped  d) is helping
items.a: **c** — حدث في الماضي خلص (last term) = past simple.

items.q:
4. I was … tired that I fell asleep on the sofa.
a) such  b) so  c) too  d) very
items.a: **b** — so + صفة (tired) + that.

items.q:
5. It was … difficult test that nobody finished on time.
a) so  b) such  c) such a  d) so a
items.a: **c** — such a + صفة + اسم مفرد (test).

items.q:
6. Which sentence best shows how the writer changed?
a) The fair was on Monday.  b) My cousin studies engineering.  c) Since then, I have volunteered to speak in every class.  d) The hall was big.
items.a: **c** — بتبيّن **التغيير** بعد التجربة.

items.q:
7. A person who guides and supports someone less experienced is a …
a) peer  b) mentor  c) customer  d) stranger
items.a: **b** — mentor (من كلمات Unit 9).

blocks.text: **ثانيًا: كمّل بالزمن الصح للفعل اللي بين القوسين**

items.q: 8. When I (arrive) at my new school, everyone (talk) in small groups.
items.a: When I **arrived**, everyone **was talking** in small groups. — الوصول حدث قصير، والكلام خلفية مستمرة.

items.q: 9. My coach (notice) that I (not / enjoy) the training.
items.a: My coach **noticed** that I **was not enjoying** the training.

items.q: 10. I (feel) so proud that I (call) my grandmother immediately.
items.a: I **felt** so proud that I **called** my grandmother immediately. — حدثين ورا بعض = past simple.

items.q: 11. While my friend (explain) the problem, I (realise) my mistake.
items.a: While my friend **was explaining** the problem, I **realised** my mistake.

blocks.text: **ثالثًا: الجملة دي من أنهي جزء؟ (Beginning / Middle / Ending)**

items.q: 12. 'My neighbour, Uncle Hamdy, was a retired carpenter who lived next door.'
items.a: **Beginning** — بتعرّف الشخص وعلاقتك بيه.

items.q: 13. 'I was so embarrassed that I wanted to leave the team.'
items.a: **Middle** — المشكلة والإحساس.

items.q: 14. 'That experience taught me that mistakes are part of learning.'
items.a: **Ending** — التغيير والدرس.

items.q: 15. 'Instead of laughing at me, he showed me how to hold the tools correctly.'
items.a: **Middle** — المساعدة.

blocks.text: **رابعًا: اربط بـ so…that أو such…that**

items.q: 16. The advice was useful. I wrote it in my notebook.
items.a: The advice was **so useful that** I wrote it in my notebook.

items.q: 17. She was a patient teacher. Every student felt comfortable asking questions.
items.a: She was **such a patient teacher that** every student felt comfortable asking questions.

items.q: 18. I was nervous. My hands were shaking.
items.a: I was **so nervous that** my hands were shaking.

blocks.text: **خامسًا: حسّن الجملة (Show, don't tell)**

items.q: 19. Improve: 'I was sad.'
items.a: مثال: **I sat alone in the cafeteria and pretended to read my book.** — بنوصف حاجة تبيّن الحزن.

items.q: 20. Improve: 'My brother helped me.'
items.a: مثال: **My brother stayed up late every night to test me on the vocabulary.** — قول عمل إيه بالظبط.

blocks.text: **سادسًا: JRE**

items.q: 21. To what extent can a single encouraging relationship change a person's future? Justify your answer.
items.a: **J:** I believe a single encouraging relationship can change a person's future to a large extent. **R:** When someone gives us honest feedback and supports us consistently, we start to believe in our own abilities and take more risks. **E:** For example, the writer of 'Finding My Place' felt like a stranger, but one conversation with a classmate led to joining the environmental club and finding a place there.

blocks.text: مهمة كتابة للتدريب (Practice Task)

text: Write a personal narrative of (150-180) words about a **coach, teacher or friend** who helped you when you felt left out or when you failed at something.

rows: Beginning
When I joined the school football team in Year 1, our coach, Captain Hany, was…
Problem
I missed an easy goal in my first match. I was so embarrassed that I wanted to quit.
Support
Instead of shouting, he stayed after training / practised with me every Tuesday / told me that every player fails sometimes.
Result
In the next match, I scored / the team cheered / I felt proud.
Change
That experience taught me that failing is part of growing. Now I…

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: الـ personal narrative = **قصة حقيقية** من حياتك بضمير **I** + **درس أو تغيير** في الآخر.
**Past simple** للأحداث، **past continuous** للخلفية والحدث المستمر (while / when).
وصّف **مشاعرك** واستخدم **so…that / such…that**، وقول الشخص عمل إيه **بالظبط**.
الطول **150-180 كلمة**، واختم بـ **That experience taught me that…**
